patthana21.26:1.1: Nahetuṃ nasekkhaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā hetu sekkho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana21.26:2.1: Nahetuṃ naasekkhaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā hetu asekkho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana21.26:3.1: Nahetuṃ nanevasekkhanāsekkhaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nahetu nevasekkhanāsekkho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Nanahetuṃ nanevasekkhanāsekkhaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nahetu nevasekkhanāsekkho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… gaṇitakena tīṇi.
